# National Autistic Society

> > The UK's leading autism charity providing comprehensive information, support, and community resources for autistic people, families, and professionals since 1962.

The National Autistic Society (autism.org.uk) is a major UK charity offering evidence-based guidance on autism characteristics, diagnosis, and support across the spectrum. The site combines educational resources, peer support communities, and practical services to help autistic individuals and their families navigate diagnosis, communication, sensory needs, and daily life.

## Key Topics

- Autism diagnosis and assessment
- Autism characteristics and traits
- Sensory processing differences
- Communication and social interaction
- Stimming and repetitive behaviours
- Routines and predictability
- Autistic women and girls
- Support needs across the spectrum
- Neurodiversity and neurodivergence
- Mental health and wellbeing
- Autism acceptance and awareness
- Online community and peer support
- Workplace inclusion
- NHS and diagnosis pathways
- SEND reform and education

## Understanding Autism

- [What is autism](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/what-is-autism): Definition and overview of autism spectrum and traits
- [About autism](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/about-autism): Overview of autism characteristics and diagnosis criteria
- [The causes of autism](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/what-is-autism/the-causes-of-autism): Evidence-based information on autism causes and myths
- [The history of autism](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/what-is-autism/the-history-of-autism): Historical timeline of autism discovery and diagnosis
- [Varying support needs](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/what-is-autism/varying-support-needs): Guide to diverse support needs across autism spectrum

## Autism Characteristics and Traits

- [Autism and communication](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/about-autism/autism-and-communication): Guide to autism communication differences and styles
- [Autism and sensory processing](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/about-autism/sensory-processing): Guide to sensory processing differences in autism
- [Repeated movements and behaviour (stimming)](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/about-autism/repeated-movements-and-behaviour-stimming): Information on stimming and self-stimulating behaviors
- [Focused and dedicated interests](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/about-autism/focused-and-dedicated-interests): Explanation of special interests in autistic people
- [Preference for order, predictability or routine](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/about-autism/preference-for-order-predictability-or-routine): Guide to autism routines and predictability preferences

## Diagnosis and Identity

- [Diagnosis](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/diagnosis): Resources for autism diagnosis journey and support
- [Autistic women and girls](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance/identity/autistic-women-and-girls): Information on autism diagnosis and gender differences

## Support and Community

- [Advice and guidance](https://www.autism.org.uk/advice-and-guidance): Hub for autism support topics and guidance resources
- [Online Community](https://www.autism.org.uk/what-we-do/community): Peer support platform for autistic people and families
- [Contact us](https://www.autism.org.uk/contact-us): Contact points, helplines, and service signposting

## Get Involved and Donate

- [Donate](https://www.autism.org.uk/get-involved/donate): Donation options to support National Autistic Society
- [News](https://www.autism.org.uk/what-we-do/news): Latest news and press releases from National Autistic Society
